summary: Implementation plan to replace generic median/fallback FEM & DEM reference values with a strict Logged-Data Geotechnical Reference Engine across Underground Mapping (Tunnel & Vertical Shaft) and Surface Mapping. Derives all 20 continuum (FEM) and discontinuum (DEM) parameters directly from area-weighted logged lithologies, logged UCS/weathering, mapped joint traces/3D dip surfaces/discontinuity sets, and structural fault/shear zones, with auto-population and one-click Apply Logged Reference Values controls.
